submission.justification: Crystal-K2 at 6 cm thickness is recommended as it achieves the best energy resolution of 2.794% at 662 keV among all viable options. This represents a significant performance advantage over Crystal-K1, which achieves only 8.488% at its optimal thickness of 6 cm. Crystal-K3, while potentially competitive, was eliminated due to exceeding the hard constraint on intrinsic background (>0.5 counts/kg/day). The 6 cm thickness for K2 was determined through systematic evaluation across the allowable range (2-10 cm), showing that this thickness optimizes the energy resolution for the facility's assay programme while maintaining compliance with all constraints.
